scenario: In-memory simulation of a melanoma guideline VERSION UPDATE. The served recommendation aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line (version 2019) is revised upstream; its text and therefore its content hash change. The demo exercises the hash-mismatch detection, the re-binding, and the before/after contract diff. NOTHING is written to the corpus; the revised text is explicitly marked SIMULATED and is not real guidance.

verdict: Governance loop demonstrated end to end: the hash-mismatch gate FIRED in both the catalog (True) and the contract (True) on the stale-hash version; the catalog re-bound cleanly to the updated record (same id=True, hash verifies=True); and the before/after contract diff surfaces the version change (2019 -> SIMULATED-2019-rev2026), the hash change, and the exact text delta for the affected melanoma case. All done in memory; the corpus on disk is untouched.
